description: This file defines menu structures, types, and functions for building user-specific menus and home sections in the Thingsboard UI, including menu IDs, mappings, filters, and role-based menu generation.

methods.name: buildUserMenu
methods.description: Generates a menu structure based on user authority from the default user menu map.

methods.name: buildUserHome
methods.description: Creates home sections for the user based on their authority and available menu sections.
